finding: GitHub temporary clone credential was captured in private repository metadata. The value was never printed or added to public GES.
scope: All seven branches created exclusively by this approved pilot attempt; exact remote/local parity and per-ref leases checked before atomic update. No other repository or owner credential was changed.

credential_probe.interpretation: Captured credential rejected by the private git endpoint; expiry/revocation not independently established.

historical_manifests: evidence-digests.json and independent-review.json describe original observations and byte digests. They are historical attestations, not validators of sanitized byte content. Use evidence-digests-sanitized.json plus independent-redaction-review.json for current custody.
historical_observations: Recorded pre-redaction main/PR SHAs remain historical facts; history repair deliberately changed current branch SHAs and does not establish fresh behavior or native acceptance.
provider_object_purge: Unreferenced commit/PR caches held by GitHub are not measured or claimed purged. Remote advertised branch histories are sanitized; private access remains required.
